tokens.font.body: "DM Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Fira Sans", "Droid Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
tokens.font.heading: "DM Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Fira Sans", "Droid Sans", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

layer.css:
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;600&display=swap");
[data-ryt="hero"] h1 { color: var(--ryt-accent); font-family: var(--ryt-font-heading); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; text-decoration-style: solid; text-decoration-color: var(--ryt-accent); text-decoration-thickness: auto; text-underline-offset: auto; transition: all }
